rationale.edition: Every changed path lives under web/src/ (components/dashboards, plugins/logs, plugins/correlation, views/Dashboards, locales/languages) plus scripts/translations/.translation_state.json. No enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths appear in changed_files.txt, so the change is open-source. The only 'enterprise' mention is an inline code comment in DetailTable.vue describing correlation-tab licensing, which is prose and does not make the change enterprise.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff is a substantial user-facing rework of the dashboard cell explorer's log detail surface (new push-nav detail mode, prev/next event navigation, inline JSON expand, correlation tab, and send-to-AI-chat forwarding), not a docs-only or CI-only change. trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty, so there is no explicit opt-out label or skip request.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: DashboardLogDrawer.vue replaces the ODrawer-based event detail with an in-place detail surface that adds back/prev/next navigation (including ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Escape keyboard handling), per-row inline JSON expansion, correlation wiring, and a wider cell-explorer drawer. ViewDashboard.vue also changes 'Copy link' to preserve cell-explorer deep-link query params. These are all user-exercisable UI flows that need verification from a dashboard.
rationale.area: The bulk of the change is in web/src/components/dashboards/ (DashboardLogDrawer, PanelContainer, PanelSchemaRenderer, TableRenderer) and web/src/views/Dashboards/ (RenderDashboardCharts, ViewDashboard); the entry point is a dashboard cell click. The existing Dashboards playwright folder under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ is the natural home.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core is the closest existing shard group in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json for a general dashboard drilldown flow (it already holds dashboard.spec.js, dashboard-share-link.spec.js, etc.). The cell-explorer log detail is a core dashboard interaction rather than a table-formatting or chart-specific concern.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — changed_files.txt contains only .vue components, locale JSON files, and a translation state file; nothing under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ was added or modified, so the new cell-explorer detail behavior has no existing Playwright coverage.
